steps.description_markdown:
Change `.bosatsu_version` from `0.0.67` to `0.0.69`. In `src/zafu_conf.json`, set `public_deps.core_alpha.version` to `9.0.1`, replace its URI with `https://github.com/johnynek/bosatsu/releases/download/v0.0.69/core_alpha-v9.0.1.bosatsu_lib`, and replace its hash with `blake3:098f5eff00611599b54b5e6bce8b7696c8fdf89f4e99f8bfbbec521764ed8927`.

These two files are the complete active release-pin inventory. Extend the existing version-file and dependency-manifest mechanism; keep `.bosatsu_platform`, launcher semantics, release runtime profile, exported packages, and package discovery settings intact. Historical plans, design documents, benchmark baselines, and synthetic test records retain their recorded versions.

Run `./bosatsu --fetch` to bootstrap the new compiler and release C runtime, then `./bosatsu fetch`, `./bosatsu check`, and `./bosatsu test`. Confirm the compiler invocation resolves beneath `.bosatsuc/cli/0.0.69` and dependency fetch accepts the declared artifact hash. If the upgrade exposes concrete compiler or core-library incompatibilities, repair only the affected repository source or tooling using existing mechanisms and `coding_style.md`; preserve established APIs, diagnostics, CLI behavior, and stack safety. Add focused regressions alongside any required semantic repair. If the pin changes work without source changes, add no new test machinery.

The slice is complete when the pins agree and these compatibility checks pass. MergeXO separately runs the required `scripts/test.sh` gate before PR publication; do not add a step to run or await that gate.
